title: A board with restrict layers 41 and 42, pads of several shapes and a hole in the package
how: Layers 1, 16, 20 and 21 have a meaning = 4 layers, 2 copper; layers 41 and 42 are read from the areas drawn on them and are no layers of the model;

one package of 6 items: 3 `pad` (octagon, long and offset shapes, each read as round with a note of code PHOENIX-EAGLE-020), 2 `smd` (roundness 50 is a rectangle with rounded corners, roundness 100 with different sides is oblong: no note) and 1 `hole` = 6 pads in the footprint and 6 placed pads for the 1 element;
1 signal with 1 contactref (pad 1 of U1) = 1 pad net; its polygon on layer 1 is 1 zone with 4 corners;

the restrict area on layer 41 has all its corners inside that pour (x 20..26 inside 2..38, y 10..14 inside 2..23) = 1 cutout of the zone; the one on layer 42 has no pour on the bottom layer to belong to and the hole of the board is not read, both counted in a note of code PHOENIX-EAGLE-022;
four wires on layer 20 close a ring = 4 outline points; one wire on layer 21 = 1 silkscreen stroke.
